Get Started

Professional Scrum Master 1

Learn about Agility and Scrum! Prepare for your Professional Scrum Master 1 Certification in 2024. Let me be your guide to earn the PSM 1 Certification from scrum.org

What you'll get out of this?

  • Learn about the scrum framework and the agile mindset
  • Understand the contents of the scrum guide
  • Access all resources required to pass the PSM 1 exam by scrum.org
  • Acquire an internationally recognized certification
  • Become a highly sought after Scrum Master, Increase your earning potential!
  • Ongoing support and mentorship

Who is this course for?

  • Product Managers/Owners, Project Managers, Program Managers,
  • Software Engineers, Software Testers, Technical Leads, Engineering Managers
  • Anyone eager to manage and deliver complex software products.

Prerequisites

  • Desire to understand the agile mindset
  • Interest in learning the Scrum framework
  • Desire to pass the Professional Scrum Master 1 exam.
  • Work experience (1-5 years preferred but not required)
